summary: Approved 5 records after independent verification: Depop’s completed 2026 sale from Etsy to eBay; VADO’s 2026 acquisition by legero united; Schwabe Group’s 2026 majority stake in Hydraid; Quadrivio/Lifestyle Fund II’s 2026 majority acquisition of Les Secrets de Loly; and Quadrivio/Lifestyle Fund II’s 2024 majority acquisition of Sessùn. Rejected pending, announced-only, minority-only, duplicate/no-change, or date-ambiguous candidates.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: eBay completed its acquisition of UK fashion resale marketplace Depop from Etsy on 2026-07-30.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: This supersedes the 2021 Etsy ownership row. eBay’s official completion release states that it completed the acquisition of Depop on 2026-07-30 and that Depop will operate as a complementary business retaining its brand, platform, customer experience, and culture. CMA clearance was announced on 2026-07-15 and published as a closed phase 1 clearance case on 2026-07-17; Etsy’s 2026-07-16 Form 8-K stated the transaction was expected to close on 2026-07-30 after CMA clearance.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completed change of control is directly supported by an official eBay completion release, with regulator and SEC evidence supporting clearance and closing mechanics.

sources.title: eBay Completes Acquisition of Depop
sources.summary: Official eBay release states that eBay completed its acquisition of Depop on 2026-07-30 and that Depop will retain its distinct brand, platform, customer experience, and culture as part of eBay.

sources.title: eBay / Depop merger inquiry
sources.summary: CMA case page states that the anticipated acquisition by eBay Inc. of Depop Limited was cleared at phase 1 on 2026-07-15 and the case was closed on 2026-07-17.

sources.title: Current Report on Form 8-K filed 2026-07-16
sources.summary: Etsy’s 8-K states that eBay agreed to acquire all outstanding equity interests of Depop Limited from Etsy, that the CMA cleared the transaction on 2026-07-15, and that the parties expected closing on 2026-07-30.

sources.title: eBay to Acquire Depop from Etsy
sources.summary: Joint announcement states that eBay entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Depop from Etsy for approximately $1.2 billion in cash, subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Austrian footwear group legero united acquired German children’s footwear brand VADO in July 2026.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: legero united’s official release states that it is expanding its brand portfolio by acquiring VADO, a German children’s footwear brand founded in 2008 and based in Donaueschingen. It also states that founder Hermann Meyer joined legero united’s Executive Board with effect from the start of July 2026 and continues to oversee VADO collection development.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official buyer-side evidence directly supports the acquisition and current integration of VADO into legero united’s brand portfolio.

sources.title: legero united acquires VADO – family-run businesses join forces. VADO-founder Hermann Meyer joins the Executive Board as Chief Product Officer
sources.summary: Official legero united release states that legero united is acquiring VADO, describes VADO as a German premium children’s footwear brand, and says VADO founder Hermann Meyer joined legero united’s Executive Board from the start of July 2026.

sources.title: A family business since 1872: our history
sources.summary: legero united’s history page states that VADO was integrated into the company in 2026 and that legero united now offers collections under superfit, legero, Think! and VADO.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Germany’s Schwabe Group acquired a majority stake in functional hydration brand Hydraid in early July 2026.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Schwabe Group’s official release states that it acquired a majority stake in Hydraid in early July 2026. The founders and workforce remain on board. The release describes Hydraid as a functional sports hydration brand with online, Amazon, and German retail distribution through dm, Budni, Rossmann, and Müller.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official buyer-side source directly confirms a completed majority-stake acquisition and current ownership/control by Schwabe Group.

sources.title: Schwabe acquires majority stake in Hydraid
sources.summary: Official Schwabe Group release states that Schwabe acquired a majority stake in Hydraid in early July 2026 and describes Hydraid as a functional sports hydration brand with broad German retail availability.

sources.title: History
sources.summary: Schwabe Group history page lists the 2026 majority-stake acquisition of Hydraid as a company milestone.

approved_deals.ultimate_owner: Quadrivio Group / Quadrivio & Pambianco Lifestyle Fund II
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Quadrivio Group’s Lifestyle Fund II acquired a majority stake in French textured-haircare brand Les Secrets de Loly in March 2026.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Quadrivio’s official release states that Lifestyle Fund II acquired the majority of Les Secrets de Loly from Quilvest Capital Partners, with Weinberg Capital Partners and Three Hills Capital Partners participating as minority investors. Founder Kelly Massol reinvested significantly and management led by CEO Carlota Thévenot remained in place. Weinberg’s release states the transaction was completed as a majority LBO with Quadrivio taking a majority stake.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official fund and co-investor releases support both completion and majority-control transfer to Quadrivio/Lifestyle Fund II.

sources.summary: Quadrivio official release states that Lifestyle Fund II acquired the majority of Les Secrets de Loly from Quilvest Capital Partners, with Weinberg and Three Hills participating as minority investors.

sources.summary: Weinberg states that Les Secrets de Loly announced completion of a majority LBO with Quadrivio Group taking a majority stake; founder and management reinvested and remain involved.

sources.summary: Legal-advisor release states that the LBO brought Quadrivio Group in as majority shareholder and saw Quilvest Capital Partners exit.

approved_deals.ultimate_owner: Quadrivio Group / Quadrivio & Pambianco Lifestyle Fund II
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Quadrivio Group’s Lifestyle Fund II acquired a majority stake in French women’s fashion brand Sessùn on 2024-09-10.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Quadrivio’s official release states that Lifestyle Fund II acquired a majority stake in Sessùn and now holds the largest share of the French brand. Experienced Capital’s minority stake was bought out, while founder Emma François-Grasset retained a minority stake and remained CEO and Creative Director.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Official Quadrivio source directly confirms a completed majority-stake acquisition, ownership result, seller context, and founder rollover.

sources.title: Lifestyle Fund II acquires French brand Sessùn
sources.summary: Official Quadrivio release states that Lifestyle Fund II acquired a majority stake in Sessùn on 2024-09-10 and now holds the largest share of the French fashion brand.

sources.summary: PDF version of the Quadrivio press release states that Lifestyle Fund II acquired a majority stake in Sessùn and that the founder retained a minority stake and her CEO/Creative Director role.
